title: Minkowski shapes of pure number fields
summary: We study the Minkowski shape of pure number fields \[ K_a=\mathbb Q(θ),\qquad θ^n=a. \] For admissible parameters satisfying an explicit local hypothesis at the primes dividing $n$, we prove a discrete--archimedean factorization \[ \mathrm{sh}(K_a)=\bigl[C(a)^{\mathsf T}\mathrm{diag}\bigl(s_1(a),\dots,s_{n-1}(a)\bigr)C(a)\bigr], \] where the $s_m(a)$ arise from normalized monomials and $C(a)\in\mathrm{GL}_{n-1}(\mathbb Q)$ comes from a normalized integral basis.
